sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The orange token is now at (21, 55), which is at the right side of the top box. The token is moving along the path toward the top box. Let me continue pressing UP to see if it enters the top box, or try LEFT to move along the top box.
Looking at the image, the orange token is at the right edge of the top box, at the junction. The top box spans from about col 5 to col 48, rows 7 to 15. The token is at row 21, col 55, which is below the top box and to the right.
Let me try UP more to see if the token reaches the top box, or try LEFT to move along the path.
Actually, looking at the path boundary more carefully:
- The path goes from (16, 57) to (35, 57) - vertical segment on the right
- Then from (35, 57) to (35, 37) - horizontal segment to yellow box
- The top box bottom is at row 15-16
- The path right side is at col 55-57
So the token at (21, 55) is on the vertical segment of the path, between the yellow box (row 35) and the top box (row 16). Pressing UP should continue moving it toward the top box.
Let me press UP more.

<parameter=code>
# Continue UP toward top box
for i in range(4):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    orange = [(n['color'], n['boundary'][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O']
    print(f"UP {i+1}: Orange at {orange}, changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
    if not last_action_result.get('board_changed'):
        print("  No change - can't go further UP")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
